# Vendored Frontend Libraries

This folder contains pinned third-party browser libraries used by the chat UI.

## Current Versions
- marked 15.0.7 (`marked.min.js`)
- DOMPurify 3.1.7 (`purify.min.js`)
- MathJax 3.2.2 (`mathjax-tex-svg.js`)

## Update Process
1. Download new pinned versions into this folder.
2. Keep filenames stable if possible to avoid template changes.
3. Validate chat markdown rendering and sanitization behavior.

## Source URLs
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15.0.7/marked.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.1.7/dist/purify.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js
